content.short: Squads is the multi-sig standard of Solana.
content.description: Squads is a multisignature wallet designed for teams building on Solana and SVM. It centralizes control of treasury, programs, validators, and tokens by requiring multiple approvals, enabling coordinated, team-based asset management across projects. Built on Squads Protocol, the most widely used and secure smart contract wallet layer for SVM deployments, Squads provides a trusted foundation for collaborative governance and asset security within your organization.
content.meta: Squads is a multisig wallet for Solana and SVM teams to securely manage treasury and assets. Discover Squads and other Web3 Wallets on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
